If unnamed species is in a Primary Thermo Library, use the name from that library.

If a species is not named in the input file, but is named in a primary thermo library,
and that name is not an ugly PrIMe ID ("s01234567") then use the name from
the primary thermo library instead of the chemical formula.

result.reasoning: This commit added the logic to rename a species using the primary thermo library name (spe.setName(...)) after the Species object (and its Chemkin-formatted NASA thermo data, which embeds the species name) had already been created. It never regenerated the NASA thermo data after the rename, leaving stale/old species names in the Chemkin thermo section — exactly the bug described in the fix commit. The fix directly adds the missing `spe.generateNASAThermoData()` call right after this same `spe.setName(...)` line introduced here.
